summary: An iOS-style animated switch built on Unity's own Toggle, so navigation still works.
overview: Built ON TOP of Unity's Toggle rather than reimplementing click, keyboard and gamepad navigation — so all of that keeps working exactly as on any other Toggle. This adds only the sliding handle and the background colour animation.
useCases: A mobile-styled UI where a checkbox looks wrong.
Any toggle that should still be gamepad-navigable.

params.tuning: The handle's local X in each state, in UI units. These are positions, not offsets, so they depend on your track size.
Short. A switch that takes noticeable time feels laggy rather than smooth.

gotchas.title: The Toggle is still the source of truth
gotchas.body: Read and write the Toggle's isOn, not this component. It only draws the state.
